# frontend

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/frontend"
```

Package frontend reads TGo syntax into a Go syntax tree.

ParseFile accepts source bytes and returns an AST with operation records. Go's standard parser reads headers and statements. The frontend prepares added syntax; the parser itself is not patched.

For postfix propagation, a named comment lets Go parse the surrounding call. The frontend then replaces that call with a marker node and records the operator, call name, and source position.

For if values, it prepares clear expression positions before parsing the file. Parsed syntax resolves ambiguous positions, such as colons in labels, map values, and slice bounds. Independent values share preparation edits; nested values can need more rounds. Placeholder function literals carry branch statements to the checker without creating source function boundaries.

Offsets map prepared text to original source bytes. Physical generated paths control build selection; diagnostic positions identify the original TGo file. This package does not check types or choose where generated statements run.

See the [checker](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/internal/checker/readme.md>) for marker types and scope, the [driver](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/internal/driver/readme.md>) for compilation and shared terms, and [measurements](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/docs/performance.md>) for parsing costs.

## func MarkPostfix

```go
func MarkPostfix(filename string, input []byte, used map[string]bool, operations map[string]Marker) []byte
```

MarkPostfix replaces postfix \! and \!\! with named comments that Go can parse. It reserves fresh names in used and records each operator in operations.

## func MarkerExpressions

```go
func MarkerExpressions(fset *token.FileSet, file *ast.File, operations map[string]Marker) map[ast.Expr]Marker
```

MarkerExpressions matches recorded comments to calls in the parsed file. It records the source call name and panics if an operator does not follow a call.

## func WrapMarker

```go
func WrapMarker(file *ast.File, expression ast.Expr, operation Marker)
```

WrapMarker replaces the selected expression with a marker call for source checking. It changes file in place and removes the comment for this operation.

## type Marker

Marker records a postfix operation in Go\-compatible source.

## type Parsed

Parsed contains Go syntax and records for the added TGo expressions.

### func ParseFile

```go
func ParseFile(fset *token.FileSet, filename, sourceName string, input []byte, used map[string]bool) (*Parsed, error)
```

ParseFile parses added expressions and maps syntax positions to the input. Conditional bodies remain statements in the original enclosing function.
